title: Unique Paths III
constraints: grid is rectangular; every cell is -1, 0, 1, or 2.
There is exactly one starting cell (1) and exactly one ending cell (2).
inputFormat: Implement uniquePathsIII(grid). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return the number of paths that visit every non-obstacle cell exactly once and finish at the ending cell.
